name: India–Pakistan
value: Indus treaty in abeyance; airspace ban to 24 Dec
summary: Pakistan extends its airspace ban on Indian aircraft to 24 Dec; Indus treaty still suspended; no cross-border strike
state: Pakistan extended its ban on Indian aircraft to 24 Dec in a NOTAM reported on 19 Nov; both countries have barred each other's airlines since April 2025 (Dawn). India's suspension of the Indus Waters Treaty, in abeyance since April 2025, remains in place. No cross-border strike or mobilisation was found to 24 Nov, so Watch holds on the treaty suspension.
for_you: Flights between Europe and South Asia operated by Indian airlines keep longer routings while the bans last. Travellers to Jammu and Kashmir and border areas should follow FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Watch: treaty suspension (Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance since April 2025); no cross-border strikes or mobilisation for Alert

sources.title: Dawn — Airspace ban on Indian aircraft extended till Dec 24
Express Tribune — Pakistan extends airspace ban on Indian aircraft until December 24

why: Two nuclear-armed neighbours with a history of rapid escalation after terrorist attacks.
drivers: Kashmir attacks, Line of Control firing, water disputes (Indus), domestic politics.

rubric.watch: Ceasefire violations, a major terrorist attack with blame assigned, or treaty suspensions.
rubric.normal: Ceasefire holding along the Line of Control; no major attacks.
